digest.en: Lula da Silva anchors the Americas agenda while the UN withdraws its political mission from Somalia after thirty years. In Oleshky, Ukrainian evacuees reunite with families as aid convoys face continued attacks.
digest.hi: ओडिशा में बाढ़ के हालात सुधरते दिख रहे हैं, जबकि आंध्र प्रदेश में नुकसान का अनुमान 4,764 करोड़ रुपये पर पहुंच गया है। जम्मू एयरपोर्ट से मध्य पूर्व और यूरोप के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय उड़ानों की तैयारी भी इसी समय शुरू हो रही है।

articles.title: Lula da Silva
articles.summary: secured victory in Brazil after finishing second in the first round. The result reflects the deep roots of the Workers’ Party, which built its support base through resistance to the military dictatorship in the early 1980s. The outcome also signals the declining appeal of Bolsonarismo. This shift marks a significant change in the country’s political alignment. The left-wing leader’s victory in Brazil, after finishing second in the first round, reflects the deep roots of the Workers’ Party, which built its support base through resistance to the military dictatorship in the early 1980s, as well as the declining appeal of Bolsonarismo.

articles.title: UN ends its Somalia political mission after three decades
articles.summary: The United Nations ended its political mission in Somalia after three decades of operation. UNSOM was established in 2013 to support the country's transition to democracy. The departure marks the conclusion of a long-standing international effort to stabilize the region. UNSOM was established by the UN Security Council in 2013 to support Somali authorities in the transition to democracy and the rule of law after more than two decades of conflict involving militias, Islamist groups and criminal gangs.

articles.title: Tears Of Joy As Ukrainians Evacuated From Russian-Occupied Oleshky Reunite With Family
articles.summary: Hundreds of residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reunited with family in Ukrainian territory. A convoy of 25 buses facilitated the transfer after a US-brokered cease-fire. The residents had lived under occupation for nearly four years. After nearly four years under Russian occupation, hundreds of residents from the southern Ukrainian city of Oleshky have arrived in Ukrainian-controlled territory following a cease-fire brokered by US first lady Melania Trump.

articles.title: The Way They Live Now In A Frigid Siberian Town
articles.summary: Residents of Tura, Siberia, queued for hours in minus 15 degree cold to buy scarce staples at high prices. The shortages stem from geographic isolation and local mismanagement. Russia's ongoing war in Ukraine has further strained the town's supply chains and economic stability. The scene outside Tura's main food store looked like something from the Soviet era: With the mercury at -15 C, residents lined up for hours to pay high prices for staples short supply.

articles.title: ‘They deserve to know the truth’: UN rights chief demands probe into staffer’s death in Houthi
articles.summary: UN human rights chief Michelle Bachelet demanded an independent probe into the death of a Yemeni UN staffer held by the Houthis for over two years. The family learned of his death only weeks after it occurred. Bachelet stated the family deserved to know the truth. The incident highlights ongoing detention practices by the Yemeni armed group. The UN human rights chief on Saturday demanded an independent investigation into the death of a Yemeni colleague held by the Houthis for more than two years, whose family learned of his death only weeks after it happened.

articles.title: Isolation deepens even as the country changes, says UN rights official
articles.summary: A UN rights official stated North Korea is more isolated than ever despite internal development. The country is building infrastructure and rolling out mobile banking. However, its population remains cut off from the outside world. The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) is building factories and hospitals, rolling out smartphones and mobile banking, and passing new laws at an unprecedented rate.

articles.title: Regardless of psywar campaign, Taiwan shouldn’t rush to surrender
articles.summary: Taiwan faces mounting pressure from China's modernized military and uncertain US backing. The Trump administration prioritizes trade deals with Beijing over security commitments. Analysts argue the island should not capitulate despite the bleak external security environment. Originally published by Pacific Forum, this article is republished with permission. Taiwan’s external security situation is bleak. China, flush with new and modern weaponry, is regularly practicing for a military operation to forcibly annex the island.

articles.title: Kosovo Protests Grow Over Killing Of Woman Who Pleaded For Police Protection
articles.summary: Protests spread across Kosovo following the killing of a woman who repeatedly sought police protection. An official investigation revealed multiple institutional failures. A prosecutor refused to act on a specific death threat against the victim. Protests are spreading across Kosovo after a woman who repeatedly pleaded for protection was killed, allegedly by her brother-in-law. An official investigation found multiple institutional failures, including a prosecutor's refusal to act on a death threat.

articles.title: How crypto hacking funds isolated North Korea’s nuclear programme
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency theft generates roughly half of North Korea's foreign currency income. The isolated state relies on sophisticated hacking to fund its nuclear program. Experts attribute significant digital thefts to state-sponsored actors. Cryptocurrency theft is estimated to generate half of the country’s foreign currency incomeNorth Korea plays by its own rules. The isolated, secretive and autocratic country is largely cut off from the world’s economic system – but when it comes to generating foreign earnings it relies on some of the world’s most sophisticated hacking. Experts, such as TRM Labs, quickly attributed the extraordinary.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery
articles.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro fled to the United States after losing the Brazilian election. He declared himself president-elect for 58 minutes. Media ridiculed the move as shameful. His letter contained the wrong coat of arms. The stunt ended in mockery. Brazilian media ridicule defeated candidate over ‘shameful’ absconsion to US and bizarre letter with wrong coat of armsFlávio Bolsonaro had hoped that by Sunday night people would be calling him the next president of Brazil. Instead, the far-right politician’s decision to flee to the US after losing the election and – for 58 minutes – to declare himself “Brazil’s true president-elect”, has made him.

articles.title: Evacuations, Humanitarian Mission Begin In Russian-Occupied Ukrainian City Of Oleshky
articles.summary: Humanitarian aid and evacuations began in Russian-occupied Oleshky under a new cease-fire. Ukrainian authorities prepared 25 buses and ambulances to move residents. Delegations from both sides arrived to coordinate the process. Remaining civilians will receive humanitarian assistance. Ukrainian and Russian delegations have arrived in Russian-occupied Oleshky as a cease-fire allows humanitarian aid deliveries and civilian evacuations. Ukraine has prepared 25 buses and ambulances to evacuate residents, while those who remain will receive humanitarian assistance.

articles.title: Oleshky ceasefire offers ‘hope’ for civilians as attacks on aid vehicles continue
articles.summary: The UN humanitarian chief stated the Oleshky ceasefire offers hope for civilians. He emphasized that residents must be able to leave safely and voluntarily. Attacks on aid vehicles continue despite the pause in fighting. Each day the ceasefire in Oleshky holds means hope for civilians in the city, the UN’s top humanitarian official said, stressing that those wishing to leave must be able to do so safely and voluntarily.

articles.title: UN rights office warns of deepening displacement ‘nightmare’ in Gaza
articles.summary: The UN human rights office warned of a deepening displacement crisis in Gaza. Israeli forces are pushing Palestinians into smaller areas while destroying infrastructure. Attacks on displacement sites continue. The office expressed concern over actions resembling ethnic cleansing. Israeli forces continue to push Palestinians into ever-smaller areas of the Gaza Strip while destroying civilian infrastructure and attacking displacement sites, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, warned on Friday amid concerns of ethnic cleansing.

articles.title: Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict, Ebola and climate shocks
articles.summary: Over twenty-eight million people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo face food insecurity. The IPC warns this number will rise in coming months. Conflict, Ebola outbreaks, and climate shocks are driving the deepening hunger crisis. More than 28 million people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are not getting enough to eat and the number is expected to tick up in the coming months, according to the latest alert from the IPC global food security monitor.

articles.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
articles.summary: UNHCR reported that over 280,000 people have been displaced by fighting in Yemen. Many vulnerable residents cannot access lifesaving relief because the conflict makes travel too dangerous. The agency highlighted the growing gap between need and delivery in the ongoing crisis. More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.

articles.title: Severe rainfall and flood warnings issued for central Greece and western Turkey
articles.summary: Powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado struck Turkey this week. Heavy rain and strong winds will continue affecting south-eastern Europe and Turkey for several days. A low-pressure system is driving the severe weather across the region. Turkey has been hit by powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado this week with more heavy rain expectedHeavy rain and strong winds will continue to affect parts of south-eastern Europe and Turkey over the next few days, as an area of low pressure in the region has allowed for the formation of powerful thunderstorms.

articles.title: What Taiwan can teach South Korea about China’s chip tech theft
articles.summary: Three South Korean engineers allegedly stole proprietary probe-card designs for a Chinese employer. They used a local firm to modify the technology. The case highlights how talent migration facilitates industrial espionage. China now produces competing components. In November 2023, three engineers left a South Korean semiconductor testing-components company for a Chinese employer offering twice their previous salaries. According to South Korea’s Intellectual Property Office, they allegedly took proprietary probe-card designs, arranged for a Korean design firm to modify them, and used the technology to develop products in China.

articles.title: Evacuation From Oleshky Completed As Buses Head To Ukraine, Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian residents left the Russian‑occupied city of Oleshky on buses for the first time in more than four years. The US‑brokered truce, running until Moscow and Kyiv say the evacuation of residents from the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky was completed "without incident," as buses filled with civilians left the area for the first time in more than four years under a US-brokered truce that is set to remain in effect until November 1.

articles.title: The rise of the nuclear hexagon and the future of Asian stability
articles.summary: US nuclear strategy remains fragmented, prioritizing the US-Russia-China triangle while treating the China-India-Pakistan dynamic as a secondary regional issue. This oversight complicates stability in Asia, where nuclear postures are shifting. Washington’s focus on the northern axis leaves gaps in understanding southern Asian deterrence. The article argues that a cohesive approach is needed to address the evolving nuclear hexagon. Originally published by Pacific Forum, this article is republished with permission.

articles.title: Pre-APEC US ban on Chinese genomic giant widens biotech decoupling
articles.summary: Washington added three Shenzhen-based firms to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act list. The move blocks imports from China's leading genomics group. This extends the trade war into biotechnology. The ban arrived weeks before US and Chinese leaders meet in Shenzhen. Beijing has vowed to defend its firms after Washington blocked imports from China’s leading genomics group, extending the two countries’ trade war into biotechnology weeks before their leaders are due to meet in Shenzhen.

articles.title: 'A Reasonable Price': Inside Iran's Illicit Trade In Babies
articles.summary: Intermediaries on Iranian Telegram channels are selling newborns for up to 1,100 dollars. They offer to falsify birth records and arrange placements abroad. This illicit trade continues despite a national ban on the sale of babies. Intermediaries on Iranian Telegram channels are offering newborns for up to $1,100 under the guise of charity, with some promising to falsify birth records and others arranging placements with Iranian families abroad, despite a ban on the sale of babies.

articles.title: The US Once Called It 'A Slush Fund For Putin.' Now Washington May Lift Sanctions On It
articles.summary: Washington is considering lifting sanctions on the Russian Direct Investment Fund. The fund's chief serves as the Kremlin's main negotiator with the White House. This move aims to normalize US-Russian ties. It also supports ongoing efforts to end the Ukraine war. Amid the swirl of efforts to end to the Ukraine war and normalize US-Russian ties, one idea under consideration: lifting sanctions on a massive Russian investment fund, whose chief is the Kremlin’s main go-between with White House negotiators.

articles.title: Moldovan President Calls Security Meeting After Massive Data Breach
articles.summary: Moldovan President Maia Sandu convened a national security meeting after a cyberattack exposed data for 750,000 people. Authorities are investigating possible foreign involvement. The attack may have utilized artificial intelligence tools to scale the breach across government systems. Moldovan President Maia Sandu has called a national security meeting after a major cyberattack exposed personal data linked to some 750,000 people.

articles.title: Can new technology keep the world’s sea lanes safe?
articles.summary: The UN Security Council debated how cheap drones, autonomous vessels, and cyberattacks threaten global shipping. Delegates examined how these emerging technologies endanger seafarers and supply chains. They also discussed tools to protect trade and energy flows. Cheap drones, autonomous vessels and cyberattacks are changing the threats to the world’s shipping lanes – and the tools to counter them. At an open debate on Thursday, the Security Council is weighing how emerging technologies could both endanger and protect seafarers, global trade and food and energy supplies.

articles.title: AI is changing the way we think. The question is whether we’ll notice in time
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence tools now handle emails, reports, and complex queries in seconds. Many users perceive this shift as comparable to the internet's arrival. The rapid integration of AI into daily workflows raises questions about how quickly humans will adapt to these cognitive changes. Artificial intelligence promises to make life easier. With a few keystrokes, it can write emails, summarize reports, generate ideas and answer complex questions in seconds.

articles.title: दुनिया के बड़े आर्थिक मंच G20 में पोलैंड को क्यों शामिल देखना चाहता है अमेरिका?
articles.summary: अमेरिका ने जी-20 में पोलैंड की भागीदारी जारी रखने का समर्थन किया। मार्को रुबियो ने कहा कि ट्रंप पोलैंड को इस मंच पर जगह देने का पक्ष में हैं। अगली बैठकों में और देशों को आमंत्रित करने की उम्मीद जताई गई। अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री मार्को रुबियो ने कहा कि राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप का मानना है कि पोलैंड वैश्विक नेताओं के इस मंच पर जगह पाने का हकदार है।

articles.title: बांग्लादेश को कैसे लूट रहा पाकिस्तान? मुस्लिम ब्रदरहुड के पीछे की असलियत हुई लीक, ट्रेड के बहाने हो
articles.summary: पाकिस्तान ने कराची से जहाजों और उड़ानों के जरिए बांग्लादेश के साथ व्यापार बढ़ाया। 11:1 के ट्रेड असंतुलन और जूट पर भारी टैक्स से बांग्लादेश को आर्थिक नुकसान हो रहा है। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार यह खेल मुस्लिम ब्रदरहुड के नाम पर चल रहा है। पाकिस्तान और बांग्लादेश के बीच नजदीकियां बढ़ रही हैं. 'मुस्लिम ब्रदरहुड' के नाम पर चल रहे इस खेल की पोल एक रिपोर्ट ने खोल दी है.

articles.title: 'मैंने अपनी बहनों से शादी करने की नहीं सोची', ट्रंप ने क्यों दिया ऐसा भद्दा बयान? इल्हान ओमर को
articles.summary: ट्रंप ने फ्लोरिडा रैली में सांसद इल्हान ओमर पर निशाना साधा। उन्होंने ओमर पर भाई से शादी और फर्जी कागजों से नागरिकता पाने के पुराने आरोप दोहराए। फिलहाल ओमर की इमिग्रेशन पेपर्स की फेडरल जांच चल रही है। रिपब्लिकन पार्टी उन्हें संसद से बाहर करने के कानूनी रास्ते तलाश रही है। डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने फ्लोरिडा की एक रैली में अपनी सगी बहनों पर अजीबोगरीब बयान दिया.

articles.summary: इजराइल के संसदीय चुनावों में विपक्षी दलों के गठबंधन को बहुमत नहीं मिला। बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू की लिकुड पार्टी सबसे बड़ी बनी, पर सरकार बनाने के लिए जरूरी सीटें नहीं मिल पाईं। इजराइल के संसदीय चुनावों में खुद को ‘ज़ायोनी’ (Zionist) कहने वाले विपक्षी दलों के गठबंधन को बहुमत नहीं मिल सका है। प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू की ‘लिकुड’ पार्टी सबसे बड़ी पार्टी बनकर उभरी है, लेकिन उनके गुट को सरकार बनाने के लिए जरूरी सीटें नहीं मिल पाई हैं।

articles.summary: प्रवर्तन निदेशालय ने ऑनलाइन गेमिंग स्कैम मामले में सागर दास को गिरफ्तार किया। मुंबई की कोर्ट ने उसे तीन दिन की कस्टडी में भेजा। यह गिरफ्तारी PMLA के तहत हुई। ऑनलाइन गेमिंग और बेटिंग स्कैम के जरिए करोड़ों रुपये की ठगी के मामले में प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ED) ने एक और गिरफ्तारी की है. ED के मुंबई जोनल ऑफिस-2 ने 27 अक्टूबर 2026 को सागर दास को प्रिवेंशन ऑफ मनी लॉंडरिंग एक्ट (PMLA) के तहत गिरफ्तार किया.

articles.summary: कांग्रेस ने बीजेपी की रैली पर पलटवार किया। पवन खेड़ा ने कहा कि दिल्ली की रैली में दस लाख लोग आएंगे। बीजेपी ने व्यापारियों की परेशानी का हवाला दिया था। 1 नवंबर को दिल्ली के रामलीला मैदान में इंडिया ब्लॉक की रैली को लेकर सियासत तेज हो चुकी है. बीजेपी के नेताओं ने रैली के कारण व्यापारियों और आमजन को होने वाली परेशानियों पर सवाल उठाए हैं.

articles.title: बाढ़ के बाद पाकिस्तान-ऑस्ट्रेलिया जैसे देशों में हुआ चमत्कार, पेड़ों पर बिछ गई ये ‘सफेद चीज’, जो
articles.summary: ऑस्ट्रेलिया के विक्टोरिया और पाकिस्तान के सिंध में बाढ़ के बाद पेड़ों पर सफेद चीजें बिछ गईं। यह प्राकृतिक घटना स्थानीय जीव-जंतुओं के लिए महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव डालती है। जब भी आसमान से मूसलाधार बारिश बरसती है और नदियां उफनकर बस्तियों में घुस आती हैं, तो चारों तरफ सिर्फ तबाही और बर्बादी का ही मंजर दिखाई देता है. इंसानों के लिए तो ये किसी बुरे सपने जैसा होता है, लेकिन क्या कभी आपने सोचा है कि उन बेजुबान और छोटे-छोटे जीव-जंतुओं पर क्या गुजरती होगी, जिनका आशियाना पानी में डूब जाता है?
